description: This file defines the ProjectSearchFilterParams class, a Data Transfer Object (DTO) used to encapsulate filtering parameters for project searches within the OrangeHRM Time plugin. It manages various filter properties such as project IDs, customer ID, employee number, and project/customer name, and sets a default sorting field.

classes.name: ProjectSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class used for specifying filter criteria when searching for projects, including project IDs, customer ID, employee number, and names. It extends FilterParams to include sorting capabilities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters with default sorting by project name.

methods.name: getProjectIds
methods.description: Returns the list of project IDs to filter.

methods.name: setProjectIds
methods.description: Sets the list of project IDs to filter.

methods.name: getCustomerId
methods.description: Returns the customer ID filter criterion.

methods.name: setCustomerId
methods.description: Sets the customer ID for filtering projects.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number associated with the filter.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number for filtering projects.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name filter for the project.

methods.name: getCustomerOrProjectName
methods.description: Returns the combined customer or project name filter.

methods.name: setCustomerOrProjectName
methods.description: Sets the combined customer or project name filter.

methods.name: getExcludeProjectIds
methods.description: Returns project IDs to be excluded from search results.

methods.name: setExcludeProjectIds
methods.description: Sets project IDs to exclude from search results.
